newsitem.title: USA: Hilton extends ITT tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Hilton extends ITT tender offer.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp Friday extended its cash tender offer for hostile takeover target ITT Corp for another month.
In a statemment, Hilton said the offer, which seeks to acquire 50.1 percent of ITT shares at $55 a share, is now due to expire on August 1, unless the company extends it again.
The offer was due to expire on June 27. So far approximately 1.3 million ITT shares have been tendered.

ITT is the owner of Sheraton hotels and Caesars World casinos. Hilton launched its bid for ITT in January but ITT quickly rejected the offer and has sold a number of non-core assets, including its stake in Madison Square Garden to focus on its main hotel and gaming operations.
ITT has approximately 122.7 million shares on a fully diluted basis, giving the transaction a total net equity value of approximately $6.5 billion.
